decisions.reason: As an organic extension close to the core assortment that remained listed through 2024, it likely meets at least acceptable aspiration levels and the firm's growth and hiring give enough slack to keep it.

Although its presentation was reduced from a dedicated page to a general mention, it is still on the website and fits the firm's salami-snack capabilities, so management would more likely retain it than redeploy resources immediately.
This 2024 launch sits directly in the firm's organic expansion path and is too new for hard performance judgments, so a boundedly rational management would usually allow more time for learning.

The product builds on existing sliced-meat know-how while supporting the strategic push into organic and ingredient-conscious options, making continued market presence more likely than early withdrawal.

This is a close-to-core organic salami variant launched only in 2024, and in a growing industry with organizational slack the firm would normally keep such an incremental product unless results were clearly below aspiration.
